verdict.rationale: Bugbot's docs say it re-runs automatically on every PR update and reads existing top-level and inline PR comments to avoid duplicate suggestions and build on prior feedback, which covers the core of not repeating old comments. The community report of getting the same recommendation again came after the user reverted the fix, so the bug had returned; it shows flip-flopping, not a concrete failure of deduplication. missing for 10: documented incremental (since-last-review) diff scoping, explicit tracking or auto-resolving of fixed findings, independent hands-on confirmation of dedup across pushes.
